t1.en: Gunmen abduct two Chinese miners in Kwali, police confirm. The FCT command said the men were taken from a quarry on Tuesday night.

t2.en: US sanctions Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger over human rights abuses, the Treasury Department said on Wednesday.

t3.en: Jihadist group JNIM claims attack on army convoy in Menaka, killing 12 soldiers and wounding several others.

t4.en: Niger has banned petrol and diesel exports to prioritise domestic supply after long queues formed at filling stations across Niamey, the capital, amid a shortage linked to refinery output.

t5.en: Chinese oil firms in Niger race to return $5.2 billion in outstanding crude payments
